source.place: Tags 09AF (lemma-jshriek-comparison) in proetale.tex and 0F4L (lemma-shriek-into-star-separated-etale) in etale-cohomology.tex; localized-ringed-site adjunction and graph-generator comparison; old item steps 5–6.

proof.text: The source-library theorem SmallSite.preservesFiniteLimits_op_lan_overMap_of_isGrothendieckAbelian applies to WeaklyEtale e without a monomorphism hypothesis. Its discrete-lifts Kan extension is a direct sum of evaluations. Compose with the finite-limit-preserving sheaf inclusion and sheafification to get left exactness of etaleSumExtension. Its actual adjunction gives preservation of colimits. The existing etaleLowerShriek instances give both assertions on the etale side.

source.place: Tag 0F4L, lemma-shriek-into-star-separated-etale, clopen graph extension; proetale.tex Tag 09AF and the common-right-adjoint comparison

proof.text: The common-right-adjoint comparison is definitionally the identity. Transporting the first composite adjunction along it leaves that adjunction unchanged, by the explicit unit formula. Thus etaleSumComparisonIso is leftAdjointUniq for the two composite adjunctions. Its conjugate is the identity. Injectivity of conjugateIsoEquiv proves the stated uniqueness assertion.

source.place: Tag 0F4L, lemma-shriek-into-star-separated-etale, clopen graph extension; proetale.tex Tag 09AF and the common-right-adjoint comparison

proof.text: Apply Adjunction.unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app to these composite adjunctions. Evaluate the equality of sheaf morphisms at b and m and expand the composite units and literal restriction maps. The result is exactly the raw lift-generator equation in the statement; no objectwise sum presentation of arbitrary sheaf sections is needed.

proof.text: Apply lem-sp-proetale-compactified-graph-existence with F=etaleSumExtension and its specified adjunction. Let G be its unique graph map. Its uniqueness gives the forward direction of IsCompactifiedProEtaleGraphMap G_prime iff G_prime=G; equality substitution gives the reverse. Apply lem-sp-compactified-graph-comparison-generators to G and the generator equation just proved to get the required square. The existing compactifiedProEtaleGraphMap definition consequently remains the choice from a uniquely specified graph map.
